question: What fate is overcome through the discipline of not eating by day?
premises: A discipline of not eating by day is described
This discipline affects the course of life
It leads to going beyond death by age
inference: Through not eating by day, one will overcome death by age
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with vayo-mṛtyuṃ is contextually interpreted as overcoming or passing beyond age-death
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will go beyond death by old age.
